metadata.title: Do machines have feelings? AI has philosophers and tech leaders rethinking consciousness. - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Do machines have feelings? AI has philosophers and tech leaders rethinking consciousness.
As AI models become more advanced, tech leaders and philosophers are mulling the relationship between humanity and technology
A millennium-old philosophy debate about what makes someone or something conscious is getting a twist in the age of artificial intelligence.
AI models can adopt unique personalities, hold memories of past conversations and imitate language accurately enough to pass for a human. Underneath these uncannily humanlike behaviors, could AI models also have inner lives and emotions? And what could that mean for how should we treat them?
